text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Whew!
Yeah, looking pretty good!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On a certain day off before the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mornin' mornin'~?
You're free, right? Let's go on a date ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was invited to go out.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ngyeeeeeeaaaaaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, ack!
No way, this is too intense, bungee jumping, eek!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, seriously, I feel so gross...
Hey, go find me a bench, will ya...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I mean, once I perk up, I wanna eat ice cream♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, so crazy-good! ♡
By the way, yours looks super yummy too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on, that strawberry!
It looks so good, lemme have a bite♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah! The cow is so super cute♡
Look at those blinking eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna take a pic with the cow♡
Hey, Trainer, take one! Take one for me~!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's way too blurry!
Take the picture when the cow is actually looking this way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her act so selfish and spoiled brings back memories of her very first day in the Twinkle Series.
choice_data_list: (It's almost been three years since then, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those thoughts in mind,
I finished our outing for the day—on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was so much fun~!
I even forgot about the Queen Elizabeth II Cup for a second~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Come to think of it, today was supposed to be a precious day off for her before the race as well."
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, why so suddenly today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did she invite me on a whim?
Or... did she have some ulterior motive?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you remember how I said
I wanted to quit after the Shuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "There was no way I could forget. It was so sudden, and so shocking."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aha, totally♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Since then, you know? I think—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
There's never been a single day where I truly, deep down,
thought of myself as a "genius."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I said it over and over! But—
I mean, I just realized it!
She's not an Umamusume on that kind of level."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-chan said that if you shine in a race,
you can lead the way, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
You, too, told me over and over
that I was a genius.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Still, looking at Ai-chan,
I really just can't be that light for her after all."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it—
I'm okay, I'm not gonna give up anymore!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: This dream is the one thing I absolutely, positively want to make come true. ...I just have to make it happen, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That's why! I thought about it!
Thought and thought—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Because you're a genius, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Because you're a genius, after all."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: In the end, they taught me.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Before the next Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
I want to believe that Fusaichi Pandora really is a genius all over again."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Ha! Aha! But honestly, it might be impossible!
I mean, I really can't believe it.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but—but, but, but still!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Even if it's just a bluff! Even if it's all just for show!
If you pump yourself up, it should give you strength!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I've been beaten down time and time again. Nothing went the way
I wanted. But even through all that—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I know I can do it!"
The courage to believe is powerful...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I want to prove it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan is...
a genius, but she's not perfect.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Because a day might come, somewhere down the line,
where I can't believe in myself anymore.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Because when that time comes, I don't even know if I'll be able to be by your side to give you a big hug.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to give her courage.
Right now, for her sake."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to run the Queen Elizabeth II Cup with that in mind.
...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through the Twinkle Series,
three years are about to pass.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's as spoiled and self-centered an Umamusume as ever, but
without a doubt—
choice_data_list: (It might not seem like it, but she's definitely changed.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, she had grown into an adult.
Seeing her shine so brightly makes me feel just a little lonely.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha.
I guess we're past the point of saying 'let's do our best together,' huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
I'll do my best♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*!
—Not yet, not yet!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaargh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With great determination,
she entered the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
From battle-hardened veterans to rising hopes,
countless of the strongest Umamusume clash today
here at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The one to watch is surely the strongest Umamusume
of the new generation who lit up the Tiara route!
Could it be Daiwa Scarlet~!?"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Standing in the way is Sweep Tosho!
Let's not forget Daring Heart, either!
And above all else—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Fusaichi Pandoraaa!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has proven her strength across numerous graded stakes!
Aiming for consecutive Queen Elizabeth II Cup titles, she stands as one of the strongest Umamusume in the field!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwooo~~~!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ race where renowned Umamusume lined up side by side.
Both the stands and the turf had reached a fever pitch—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Miss Pandora?
What's wrong, all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Something really did happen, didn't it? That day,
I couldn't help thinking you weren't acting like yourself...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Ai. What I'm about to say
is gonna sound super uncool, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Truth is, I have no confidence at all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't make my dream come true.
I was just overconfident.
I never had any talent to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: She was just an ordinary, regular Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That's—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: But you know! Just for today, I want to forget about everything!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'll show ya the greatest race in the world.
It might look super uncool, but still—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Just watch. Watch me believe in myself."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Aha.
Well, I've done a lot of training, after all.
It might just be a piece of cake.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Because I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora raised her head,
—and tightly clenched her trembling hands.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I'm just a genius after all♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Whose hands will grasp that hope?
The curtain rises on the Queen Elizabeth II Cup."
